items.title: Billie Pierce and De De Pierce Interview, 1959-10-07
items.q: I went and worked with Mealy down there and put a hitbitter band in there.

ctx.x: Well, they put a white band in there, he'll be the best. It was Mealy Jar, but, man, he wasn't in my way, it was Mealy Jar. I went and worked with Mealy down there and put a hitbitter band in there.
Well, they got on the host, I mean, he managed on the host.
